technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions with bullish micro-structure signals are offset by bearish stochastic cross, price below intermediate moving averages, and weak trend confirmation; high-probability swing entry is not supported.

fundamental.summary: EEM shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; insufficient data for directional bias.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (356.16) combined with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event creates severe macro headwinds for emerging markets exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) presents contrarian buy opportunity with price near support (38.5238) and short-term overbought micro-signals (RSI, Stoch, AO cross-up) suggesting potential bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis regime, flat yield curve, NFP event risk), price is below all intermediate moving averages (EMA-50, SMA-50), stochastic bearish cross is active, and fundamental/smart-money conviction is absent—risk/reward is asymmetrically negative.
